objects.name: bird
objects.description: phoenix/peacock-like fantasy bird seen from above: green head, body and wings, long red-orange tail fan with eye-spot feathers and a long thin central green tail shaft; the only moving object
objects.heading: flies toward image left (-x), roughly along row y~715

objects.flap_cycle: wing-spread maxima at frames ~10, 21, 35, 46, 60, 71 (period ~12.5 frames ~0.52 s); minima at ~13-14, 38-39, 63-64

objects.name: terrain
objects.description: static snowy mountain ground seen from above: grey shaded rock ridge/cliff on the left (x ~0-900 px), snowfield in the centre with brown rock streaks, sunlit tan rock ridge on the right (x ~1950-2560 px, gully at x~2250-2300). No man-made objects or markings.

events.event: bird accelerates: beak step ~3-4 px/frame at frames 2-6, ~4-8 px at 7-25, ~14-20 at 26-45, ~25-30 at 52-71 (speed pulses with wingbeats)
